name: paged
description: The root server has no cursor: the census returns every computer id and the walk cuts them into id ranges of page_size. With five computers and page_size=2 there must be three range queries, and the second and third must carry the ids the census returned rather than re-reading the first range. The route for each range matches on the upper bound embedded in the relevance, so a walk that failed to advance would starve and the run would fail.
